dog.description_text: Meet Feathers! This one-year-old bundle of energy is looking for his forever home. Feathers is a fetch-playing, bird-watching, lap-napping cat who will keep you thoroughly entertained. He loves his spring toys so much that if you throw one, he just might bring back two. When he's not glued to the window watching birds, he's curled up beside you—or right in your lap. Feathers is affectionate and enjoys chin scratches and face pets, though like many young cats he can get overstimulated and may nip during play. He's still learning his limits, and a patient adopter who understands kitten energy will bring out the best in him. Close a door and he may meow outside it—he just misses you. He's a clean, well-kept cat with loads of personality. If you want a cat who actively participates in your life rather than just tolerating it, Feathers is your guy. He is also best as the only cat in your home.
dog.name: Feathers
